members.responsibility: Owns the transport layer and the ServerInstance seam: the module, query and document-authority ports, the instance-generic server state, lane fan-out, the presence rooms every socket reads by cursor (bounded per frame and in total) and colour leases, CORS, credential extraction, blob and static-app hosting, the replay-then-live event bridge, the command lane and the command/query endpoints, the route groups an instance mounts and the edge that applies the throttle (client address, request class, the body taken within its limit and its time, bounded sockets, the error bodies) — everything the server builder wires together.

Runs the actor turn protocol: fenced activation, the admit/dedupe/authorize/decide/commit pipeline, deterministic deciders shared with the optimistic replica, and the saga seam for cross-actor workflows.

Bounds what one client address may ask and what an instance carries at once: per-address token buckets for writes, reads and socket upgrades, caps on open sockets per address and in total and on requests in flight, over a bounded table of addresses with IPv6 keyed per /64.

Defines the four durability roles an authority needs as separate contracts — authority store, rebuildable projections, content-addressed blobs, sessions — and no implementation of any of them: the instance names the backend for each role.
Evaluates authorization at every decision point from policy templates held as data, resolves principals through an instance-supplied credential ladder, and gates administration.
Defines the command/query envelopes, outcomes, offline policies, actor keys, lane records and instance manifests every party agrees on without sharing a runtime.
